products.name: him shoes
products.description: Premium materials selected for comfort, durability, and everyday wear.

products.name: BGY Aero-1 Proto
products.tagline: A bold everyday sneaker selected for comfort and confident movement
products.description: The Aero-1 Proto brings a clean athletic profile, breathable materials, and responsive cushioning together for everyday movement. Selected by BGY for customers who want dependable comfort and distinctive style.

reviews.title: Insane comfort and striking aesthetic
reviews.comment: The transition between the B-G-Y design ethos shows in every stitch. The shoe is lighter than expected and turns heads everywhere.

reviews.title: Flawless minimalism
reviews.comment: High build quality, genuine leather accents, and the crimson detail is just subtle enough. True to size.

products.name: BGY Phantom Low
products.tagline: Architectural monochrome luxury for everyday motion
products.description: Stripped of all noise. The Phantom Low is molded from premium buttery calfskin leather with a concealed lacing tunnel and bespoke BGY sculptured cupsole. A masterclass in modern restraint and tactile luxury.

reviews.title: Best daily sneaker I own
reviews.comment: Clean silhouette. Works seamlessly with tailored trousers or casual denim. Highly recommended.

products.name: BGY Gravity High
products.tagline: Futuristic high-top with ankle lockdown stabilization
products.description: Drawing inspiration from aerospace materials and urban brutalism. The Gravity High anchors the ankle with a padded geometric collar, reinforced red stitching accents, and an energy-returning rocker outsole.

reviews.title: Head turner
reviews.comment: The collar support is unmatched. Materials feel worth $500. Solid BGY statement.

products.name: BGY Velocity Evo
products.tagline: Pure performance marathon trainer with explosive rebound
products.description: Engineered for relentless road mileage. Powered by an internal full-length carbon fiber propulsion plate sandwiched between two layers of BGY Float-Matrix foam. The featherweight monofilament upper conforms like a second skin.

products.name: BGY Monolith-X
products.tagline: Sculptural exaggerated sole with architectural balance
products.description: Challenging classic footwear proportions. The Monolith-X features a bold faceted geometric midsole that absorbs heavy impact while maintaining surprising lightness. Finished with waterproof bonded technical seams and a laser-etched BGY emblem.

products.name: BGY Apex Carbon
products.tagline: Featherweight track-inspired racer with laser precision
products.description: Designed for sharp city sprints and clean styling. Incorporates real carbon lateral wings that prevent rollover and provide instantaneous directional feedback.

products.name: BGY Strata Mid
products.tagline: Modern mid-cut silhouette tailored with precision panels
products.description: An understated mid-profile height that protects the ankle while maintaining effortless agility. Clean tonal panels and minimalist branding.

products.name: BGY Pulse Hybrid
products.tagline: Seamless 3D circular knit slip-on with dynamic tension bands
products.description: No laces required. The Pulse Hybrid wraps the foot in variable compression zones that flex as you sprint or walk. Features an integrated red stabilization bridge on the medial arch.

products.name: BGY Vortex 01
products.tagline: Tactical sneaker featuring Fidlock magnetic fast-lock closure
products.description: Designed for rapid transitions and hostile urban environments. Built with weather-sealed zippers, reflective 3M BGY coordinates, and high-traction all-weather lugs.

specs.upperMaterial: Water-Repellent DWR Coated Ripstop & GORE-TEX lining

products.name: BGY Shadow Runner
products.description: Subtle by day, luminous under city lights. Engineered for dawn and dusk runners who demand uncompromising style and top tier road protection.

specs.upperMaterial: Engineered Engineered Air Mesh with 3M Threads

products.name: BGY Kinetic Prime
products.tagline: Asymmetrical speed trainer with targeted lateral support
products.description: The Kinetic Prime rethinks how the foot articulates during explosive training. The asymmetrical lacing relieves instep pressure while the high-rebound forefoot plate stores energy.

products.name: BGY Zero-Grav Slide
products.tagline: Post-workout recovery slide molded in single-piece bio-foam
products.description: Sculpted from a single injection of high-density sugarcane foam. Features an orthotic arch cradle and drainage channels for seamless post-run relaxation and poolside leisure.
